messages:
mohit: kicking off deploywave 78 (dry-run) — goal: sanity-check API/runtime/console/router interop. holding at quiet window 02:00-03:00 UTC. please confirm header-split and KV-cache-evict behavior across stacks.
sarah: noted. runtime team has a small kernel batching tweak in this wave, should be compatible but will verify KV eviction ordering.
dmitri: router: header-split flag is on in staging; no obvious regressions. will run a quick traffic-stew smoke on canary.
ryan: console: UI schema change is backwards compatible, but signal that telemetry tags will change names. planned to ship toggle in UI after runtime confirms.
carla: api: rolling out compat shim for the new header format. will keep legacy header parsing for 48h.
mohit: deployed shepherd hold at preflight. if everyone thumbs-up, i'll push the deploybot step to advance the wave to staging canary.
deploybot: Wave 78 dry-run: preflight checks passed (quota, images, certs). Holding for manual advance. Use `@deploybot advance 78 --staging` to continue.
ops-jen: quick note — if staging latencies jump >15% during canary, abort and pin to previous model. set alerts to critical.
sarah: running runtime KV eviction regression now (small set of synthetic traffic). ETA ~5m.
dmitri: started router smoke: 1% of staging traffic to canary, validating header routing + debug logs.
sarah: KV eviction ordering looks fine, no double-evict observed. memory profile ok. :thumbsup:
carla: api shim returning both headers for compatibility. logs show both header paths hit.
ryan: console picks up the new telemetry names when query param telemetry=v2; no fallout on older clients.
mohit: all teams reported green. advancing to staging canary in 30s. reminder: rollback criteria—latency >15% or error-rate >2% for 5m.
deploybot: Wave 78: advanced to staging canary. Canary id: cw-78-stg. Monitoring hooks attached.
dmitri: router: observing small increase in 95th pct (<6%), within threshold. keeping watch.
sarah: runtime: tail latency unchanged, CPU steady. ruling out kernel-batching side effects.
ryan: console: no client errors. telemetry shows expected tag rename spike (telemetry=v2).
mohit: ok — unless someone calls abort in next 10m, we move to broader staging. call out if you see anything anomalous.
ops-jen: setting a temporary alert threshold relaxer so noisy infra won't auto-abort the dry run. manual abort still honored.
carla: one minor 500 in api; correlating stack traces — seems unrelated (downstream rate limiter). will patch after wave.
dmitri: router noticed a fallback path for 0.4% of requests — investigating whether header ordering caused it.
sarah: runtime logs show a single backend reconnect, explains fallback. not systemic.
mohit: thanks — proceeding to broad staging. tagging release notes as draft: "shepherd wave 78: header split + KV eviction ordering, runtime kernel batching opt"
deploybot: Wave 78: advanced to broad staging. Canary window 15m. Auto-rollback windows enabled with ops thresholds.
ryan: quick request — add a console note in release notes about telemetry param so support can triage faster.
mohit: added note. Sarah/Dmitri/Carla — please add one-line bullet each on observed behavior for the release notes.
sarah: added: "runtime: KV eviction ordering validated; no regression observed in synthetic traffic"
dmitri: added: "router: header split routing verified; observed 0.4% fallback due to transient backend reconnect, not header logic"
carla: added: "api: compatibility shim active for 48h; will remove legacy parser in follow-up wave"
mohit: excellent. wrapping dry-run now — no rollbacks. tagging wave 78 as dry-run-success. will schedule prod cutover planning next week. :party-parrot:
deploybot: Wave 78: dry-run SUCCESS. Artifacts: cw-78-stg logs + perf dumps at s3://deploy-artifacts/wave78/dryrun/
ops-jen: leaving post-run note: let's keep a short postmortem checklist item on verifying telemetry ingestion for first 24h after prod.
mohit: noted and created a ticket. thanks all.
